prompts.tentacleStrike: Create a production animation SPRITE SHEET based on this exact clean Kraken asset. EXACTLY 6 frames, arranged in a precise regular THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Transparent alpha background for the entire sheet; no grid lines, text, frame numbers, shadows, scenery or UI. Each cell is square, same dimensions, same character scale, same unchanging camera, central mantle/head fixed around the same anchor and tentacle resting line fixed at 86% cell height. Keep ample transparent padding in EVERY cell, including above the head, so nothing crosses cell boundaries. Preserve exact clean smooth fantasy game art: dark violet/navy Kraken, pale bone armor, hooked beak, narrow teal eyes, cyan sucker rings and spiral runes; no grain, no dithering, no pixel-art filter. Show the entire Kraken in every frame. This is TENTACLE SLAM, a single-target attack to the LEFT. Animate ONE large front-left tentacle, with the other tentacles bracing and mantle remaining steady. Frame 1 ready pose matching reference, frame 2 front-left tentacle coiling backwards, frame 3 raised and poised to strike, frame 4 tentacle driving sharply down and left with a fully extended pointed end, frame 5 tentacle retracting after impact, frame 6 settled into the original ready pose. Each intervening frame must be a genuinely distinct anatomical pose, not the identical creature translated, rotated or scaled. The main mantle stays upright and the attack is performed by the flexible limb. No added limbs, no detached arms, no cropped frame edges. Crisp clean alpha silhouettes. Deliver one transparent 3x2 sprite-sheet image with all six cells clearly separated by empty transparent gutters.
prompts.tentacleSweep: Create a transparent production game animation sprite sheet for the EXACT Kraken in this reference, preserving its clean smooth dark violet/navy design, bone armor, hooked beak, teal eyes, luminous cyan suckers and spiral runes. EXACTLY TWELVE frames in a regular FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS grid; square equally sized cells. Read in row-major order. No frame labels, lines, numbers, background, fog, ground, shadows or UI. Actual alpha must be completely zero outside each creature, no ambient glow filling the empty cell. Each entire creature stays inside its cell with empty transparent margins and gutters. Keep fixed camera, fixed head/mantle scale, head anchor and resting tentacle baseline at the same position in every cell. This action is MULTI-TENTACLE ASSAULT, NOT a sideways tail sweep and NOT translating or rotating the whole creature. Several separate muscular tentacles coordinate attacks to the LEFT: 1 neutral ready, 2 front tentacles tense, 3 two front arms raise, 4 four tentacles coil upward in visibly different arcs, 5 four limbs fully poised, 6 first pair lashes toward separate left-side targets, 7 second pair follows while first pair recoils, 8 three or four arms extended at different heights attacking multiple locations simultaneously, 9 overlapping whipping tentacle arcs at peak attack, 10 first pair retracts, 11 remaining pair recoils, 12 all limbs settle back to reference stance. Keep trunk mostly still; motion must come from multiple visibly changing tentacle shapes. No dismemberment, no extra limbs, no overlapping cells. Consistent lighting and polished clean shading, no pixelated or grainy textures. One transparent 4x3 sprite sheet, exactly 12 distinct sequential anatomical poses.
prompts.tidalWave: Create a production animation sprite sheet for this EXACT clean Kraken creature, preserving anatomy, armor, hooked beak, dark purple/navy body, teal eyes, turquoise sucker rings and head spirals. EXACTLY TWENTY sequential frames on a precise FIVE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS grid. Equal square cells, row-major order, one full Kraken per cell, same size/camera/body anchor, lower resting tentacle baseline always at 86% cell height. Empty transparent gutters; all limbs fully inside every frame. Genuinely transparent alpha, all empty cell pixels fully transparent. NO labels, frame numbers, grid lines, studio background, fog or environmental scenery. This is the largest attack: TIDAL WAVE, a dramatic twenty-frame cast toward the LEFT. Sequence: frames 1-3 neutral into bracing crouch; 4-7 multiple tentacles lift upward in a spreading fan as suction cups and runes brighten; 8-10 raised arms draw back, small tightly contained curls of cyan water gather between them; 11-14 arms thrust forward together releasing a foaming cyan wave surge toward the left along their bases, the main crest attached to and close to the tentacles so everything fits within the cell; 15-17 water cast fades as limbs recoil; 18-20 settle back to original stance with no water remaining. Every frame must show incremental articulated tentacle movement, not a translation/rotation/scale of an identical image. Main head and mantle remain stable in size and placement. Frame20 matches ready stance. Keep water effects clearly secondary and transparent outside their narrow painted shapes, no full opaque ocean or background. Smooth polished fantasy game shading, sharp anti-aliased silhouettes, clean readable forms, no grain, no stippling, no pixelated rendering. ONE transparent 5x4 sheet with all 20 frames exactly.
prompts.special: Create a production animation sprite sheet of the EXACT Kraken in this clean reference: dark violet/navy armored cephalopod, pale bone plates, hooked beak, narrow teal eyes, turquoise sucker rings and spiral markings. Exactly TWENTY sequential frames in an evenly spaced FIVE-COLUMN FOUR-ROW grid, one complete creature inside each square cell, read left-to-right across each row then down. Fixed camera and scale, head/body anchored identically, resting tentacle baseline at 86% cell height, transparent gutters with no overlap. True alpha transparency, fully clear outside the painted creature, no background gradient or ground/fog/shadows/text/numbers/grid. Action: INK HEX SPECIAL, 20 frames. 1-3 ready pose into a slight ritual coiling of the forward tentacles; 4-7 suckers brighten in a traveling sequence up the arms and the spiral head markings begin glowing; 8-11 several tentacle tips lift and curl into rune-like loops as the head spirals flare vivid turquoise; 12-14 peak spell cast with strongly luminous suckers, cyan runes tracing the mantle, a small distinct cyan magical spiral floating just above the beak between the raised arms; 15-17 discharge the glow outward and relax the arms; 18-20 fade to normal sucker brightness and return to the original stance. No big surrounding aura or background glow: light stays on the creature/runes and the small spiral. Distinct incremental anatomical movement and changing light state in every frame, no duplicated resized copies. Keep creature menacing and all anatomy consistent. Smooth clean fantasy game illustration with sharp anti-aliased contours and readable broad shading, no grain, dithering or pixel art. Entire creature and small spell glyph fully contained within every cell. One transparent 5x4 animation sheet.
